deviations.why: No reservation flow exists in the Vitrina product; the contact section shows info and map instead.
Team members are only allowed with REAL_OWNER_PERSON; no such data is available.
Video modal is not supported by the product.

deviations.what: Weekly special tabs adapted to a services list
deviations.why: Tabs require client-side state; server components cannot maintain active tab state, so the content becomes a static list of services.

deviations.what: Contact map card moved to full width
deviations.why: Gives the shared FindUs component enough horizontal space to render its map content without clipping, as required by the performance audit.

notes: This is the JSX step only. The CSS module will address the --vt-on-accent contrast fix and the horizontal overflow of .root/.navIn in the next iteration. The only JSX change from the previous version is moving .contactCard outside .contactInner so it occupies the full row.
